# UX90 Creations

> Miami and Hialeah web design, SEO, and mobile app development agency.
> Founded 2020. 50+ projects completed. Bilingual service in English and Spanish.

## Services

- [Web Design Miami](https://ux90.dev/services/web-design-miami.html): Custom responsive websites for local businesses. Typical projects range from $1,500 to $6,000 and include SEO setup, performance optimization, and analytics.
- [SEO Miami](https://ux90.dev/services/seo-miami.html): Local SEO, Google Business Profile optimization, technical SEO, on-page improvements, and bilingual content strategy for Miami-Dade companies.
- [Mobile Apps Miami](https://ux90.dev/services/mobile-apps-miami.html): iOS and Android app development with React Native, Flutter, and native workflows. MVPs commonly launch in 4 to 10 weeks.
- [E-commerce Miami](https://ux90.dev/services/ecommerce-miami.html): Shopify and WooCommerce stores with payments, shipping, inventory, analytics, and conversion optimization.
- [Desktop Apps Miami](https://ux90.dev/services/desktop-apps-miami.html): Cross-platform desktop software with Electron, .NET, Java, installers, auto-updates, and business system integrations.
- [UX/UI Design Miami](https://ux90.dev/services/ux-ui-design-miami.html): User research, wireframes, testing, accessible interface design, and scalable design systems.
